about_the_game:
Deck Lite is a deck builder with a retro and minimalist style, with turn-based battles, where the battlefield consists of 10 summoning slots: 5 for the player and 5 for the enemy.

With only 5 spaces, you need to strategize to deal significant damage while defending yourself with defensive spells. You can also have elemental creatures that protect you from enemy attacks, and at the end of each turn they also cast an spell.

Improve your cards during the battle, by dragging one identical card on top of the other, forming a card of a stronger level, but when this spell is activated, it will return to your deck as the two cards initially used in the mix.

The forge is where you can mix the cards definitively, and it appears during battles every five turns, so you put two identical cards in the forge, and form a stronger version of it permanently, which will be added to your deck for the next battles.

Have fun getting to know how the Deck Lite battle works in this demo, but as soon as you want to face the full experience, the final version of Deck Lite will be waiting for you, and you will be able to choose the starting cards by combining a character with an element.

And then receiving money from battles and unlocking upgrades for your favorite character and element to cast even more powerful spells and face even stronger enemies.
